root_idea.summary: The root centers on a shelter or place of return: a dwelling in which people gather and reside. From this comes the sense of a house, household, and any structure understood as a joined or encompassing whole.
root_idea.development: The lexical development extends from dwelling and residence to the household and to the poetic verse as a structured collection of words. Its verbal branch specializes in being or acting through the night, then in planning or attacking by night; related derivatives describe nighttime states, provisions, and things left overnight.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The T-tagged occurrence is the same temporal lexeme بَيَاتٌ as the nominal group, used adverbially in context.

senses.definition: To spend or pass the night, or to be engaged in a stated activity during the night.
senses.usage_conditions: The verb describes nighttime residence or activity and does not by itself require sleep; in the Quranic occurrence it describes worship through the night.

senses.definition: To deliberate, devise, or formulate a matter, especially through nighttime consideration.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, the object may be a course of action or words that are privately considered and prepared; the nighttime framing is part of the conventional construction.

senses.definition: To attack or come upon people by night, taking them by surprise.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of a nighttime assault upon an enemy or people while they are heedless.

senses.definition: Nighttime; by night or during the night.
senses.usage_conditions: Used adverbially to mark when an event occurs, including an event that comes in the latter part of the night.

senses.definition: A coming upon or attacking an enemy by night; a sudden nighttime arrival of harm.
senses.usage_conditions: The term can describe a night raid or, in warning contexts, punishment arriving by night while people are unaware or asleep.

senses.definition: A house, dwelling, tent, or other built shelter; by extension, a residential structure or premises.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic noun covers structures made of stone, earth, wool, hair, or similar materials, including ordinary homes, tents, and uninhabited buildings used by travelers or for commerce.

senses.definition: A designated sacred house or place of worship, especially the Kaaba, the House of God.
senses.usage_conditions: The definite singular can designate the Kaaba, while plural بُيُوت may denote mosques, sanctuaries, or other specially designated religious houses in Quranic contexts.

senses.definition: The household or people associated with a house; a house understood as a family or group.
senses.usage_conditions: In the construction أَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ, the expression denotes the people of the house and can function as a defined family designation.

senses.definition: Noah’s ark, in a Quranic interpretation of بَيْت in the account of Noah.
senses.usage_conditions: This is a specialized interpretive application in the passage at 71:28, not a general synonym for an ordinary house.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become, remain, or be in a particular place or state, whether by night or by day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A use parallel to كَانَ or صَارَ, without the ordinary restriction to nighttime.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To marry or take a wife; in another usage, to give a woman in marriage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived or figurative marriage-related use, distinct from the ordinary nighttime verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To construct or build a house or tent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Takes the house or structure as its object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To retain or defer property until night instead of distributing it promptly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in a conventional expression concerning delaying the disposal of property.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To trim or prune palm trees by cutting off stumps or straggling branches.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to pass or enter upon the night in a particular condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative Form IV use, often occurring in wishes for a good or safe night.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To withhold or debar someone from what they want.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a person and the desired object or need.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek, require, or possess food or provision sufficient for a night.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical discussion reports both the seeking or requiring of food and the contrary state of having a night’s provision; the related noun can therefore describe neediness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pavilion, palace, mansion, or substantial residence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized extension of the sense of a built dwelling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A grave.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or comparative use for a place that receives and contains the dead.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An animal’s constructed habitation, such as a burrow, hole, or spider’s web.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from a human dwelling to an animal-made shelter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man’s wife.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative household-related use; some contexts instead intend the household as a whole.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The nobility of an Arab tribe, or the family comprising its noble line.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a distinguished house or lineage rather than a physical dwelling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A noble or eminent person, regarded as the chief of his people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A metonymic extension from a noble house to its outstanding member.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The furniture, equipment, or household provisions sufficient for a tent or house.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in marriage and household arrangements for the furnishings supplied with a dwelling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A verse or line of poetry, especially one composed of recognized metrical divisions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A metaphor based on the joining of words and metrical parts as the components of a tent or house; it may also denote the chief verse of a poem.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A manner, condition, or state in which one passes or enters upon the night.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun or substantive derived from بَاتَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Food or victuals sufficient for a night.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially in expressions denying that someone has a night’s supply of food.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having remained for a night and consequently becoming stale, especially of bread.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes the effect of overnight keeping.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Cold or cool from having remained overnight, especially of water or milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of liquid left beneath the sky or in a skin during the night.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Persisting through the night, especially of an affair causing anxiety or grief.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a troubling matter or emotion that occupies someone during the night.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tooth that does not fall out or become shed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place in which one passes or enters upon the night.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A place-of-stay noun derived from the nighttime verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who has obtained a house or its furnishings together with a husband.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional description of a married woman established with a household.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Poor or needy, lacking more than food or possessing only food and nothing beyond it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived designation connected with the possession or lack of a night’s provision; synonymous with فقير in this use.

cautions: The Form I verb بَاتَ has a classical disagreement over whether sleep is entailed; the Quranic occurrence clearly concerns passing the night in worship, while the verb itself primarily marks nighttime activity or residence.
The ark sense is a specialized Quranic interpretation of بَيْت in 71:28 and should not be generalized to the ordinary noun meaning.
The T-tagged بَيَات occurrence is accounted for with the nominal temporal form because the evidence supports the same lexical item used adverbially.
